intent: Unify shader controls + observability into a single calm cockpit that still feels alive.

ingredients.note: The universe-feel is the north star: everything must glow with meaning.
Controls, telemetry, and visuals must flow together without friction.
Keep one human pulse in the interface: warmth, not just precision.
Naming + grouping is the truth layer; no slider without a reason.
Single-file deployment, predictable state, no dependencies.
Allow playful toggles (hue, EM, magnetism) to invite discovery.
Seeded randomness as oracle, not as clutter.
Safe defaults, but not a cage; keep the door open.
The ‘aha’ moment: one button that reveals the universe behind the numbers.

operations.notes: Kill duplicate controls; keep only what changes experience. Constraint: single-file, offline.
Prototype UI grouping fast; let the shader run wild while controls settle.
Core: (1) field params, (2) color/energy, (3) observability. Decorations later.
Bind UI -> shader uniforms -> telemetry in one loop, with stable naming.
Leave one unknown: emergent interference patterns from parameter coupling.
Refactor: remove 2 sliders, merge 2 metrics, rename 5 params for clarity.
Ship: a single HTML file + a one-page readme; witness: screen-recorded 30s tour.

counter_spell: Ship the smallest living ritual; refinement can orbit the release.
balance_next_step: Add one concrete anchor line in the UI (‘temperature of the void: …’) and publish the file.

ritual.anchor: The laptop fan warms the room like a small sun.
ritual.stake: I want the cockpit to welcome curiosity instead of intimidating it.
ritual.spell: So I let noise become constellations, and structure become a gentle handrail.
